mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_consult (student_name, consult_date, school, grade_key, phone, inflow_route_key, progress_key, content, created_at) VALUES (#{studentName}, #{consultDate}, #{school}, #{gradeKey}, #{phone}, #{inflowRouteKey}, 'counseling', #{content}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.student_name AS studentName, c.consult_date AS consultDate, c.school AS school, c.phone AS phone, c.content AS content, g.grade_name AS gradeName, i.inflow_route_name AS inflowRouteName, c.progress_key AS progressKey FROM ERP_CONSULT c JOIN erp_grade_code g ON c.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_inflow_route i ON c.inflow_route_key = i.inflow_route_key

SELECT c.id AS id, c.student_name AS studentName, c.consult_date AS consultDate, c.school AS school, c.phone AS phone, c.content AS content, g.grade_name AS gradeName, i.inflow_route_name AS inflowRouteName, c.progress_key AS progressKey FROM ERP_CONSULT c JOIN erp_grade_code g ON c.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_inflow_route i ON c.inflow_route_key = i.inflow_route_key
AND c.consult_date BETWEEN CONCAT(#{startYm}, '-01') AND EOMONTH(CONCAT(#{endYm}, '-01'))
ORDER BY c.consult_date DESC
